name: RoomDrop
summary:
RoomDrop is a mixed reality interior-planning app that lets you place and arrange virtual furniture in your real environment.

Use your room as a canvas: place furniture around you, move and rotate objects, and explore different layouts directly in mixed reality. Save your favorite arrangements and return to them later.

RoomDrop makes it easier to visualize furniture placement and experiment with room ideas before making real-world changes.

Features
Place virtual furniture in your real space

Move, rotate
